BootUI records the stacks that advertise each tool; sharpit has one stack, so the manifest has no stacks field and the stack-specific test is not ported
BootUI's generator adds idHelp and queryHelp from McpToolGuide; sharpit has no such guide yet, so the fields are omitted (BootUI omits them when it has none)
BootUI writes a hand-made example per tool (McpToolGuide.example); sharpit generates `sharpit <command>` plus the id and --scan-id placeholders from the schema

sharpit adds `arguments` (the wire names, camelCase as the tool schema declares them) and `required` so the CLI sends exactly what is supplied and refuses a missing required argument; BootUI's CLI derives them from the schema name
